notes.title: 3D mod
notes.notes:
We have recently added 3D mod to Spherecraft. Just put on red-blue 3D glasses and enjoy building world of spheres in 3D.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35039577/837863d3ef7d42ca9d10c2016fb60a3baa924d01.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35039577/2bae69924599cc682acb1ee16746c668c04455fa.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Spherecraft is now multiplayer
notes.notes: Hello, we have recently added multiplayer to Spherecraft. You can now play in rooms with up to 10 players, build together and chat with your friends.
